supercharger_access.notes: Quick web lookup. Canadian article (Sept 2024) on the GM NACS adapter for Canadian owners of Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ. Says nothing about 2026 trim ports.

charge_port.notes: Article: 2027 gets NACS instead of the CCS1 used in the 2024-2026 model years. US site; Canadian 2026 truck assumed the same (GM Canada adapter programme for Silverado EV implies CCS1).

wheels.notes: US Cars.com: Extended Range LT 18 x 8.5 in aluminum (applied to both charger trims).

ac_max_kw.notes: NRCan lists this car as "(11.5 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time. NRCan 2026 rows name both charger versions.
